acceptanceCovered: Compose pill on /sun-kudos opens the 'Viết Kudo' modal (title, fields in Figma order, Hủy + Gửi footer); viewer without a sunners row sees the pill disabled; guests are sent to /login — proof: compose pill opens modal; disabled without sunner row (readComposeAccess/hasSunner); guests via proxy guard

Người nhận: placeholder 'Tìm kiếm'; trimmed, case- and diacritic-insensitive search of sunners (max 10, excludes self, literal special chars, empty result message); selecting fills the field and closes the list — proof: recipient search trimmed, case/diacritic-insensitive, <=10, excludes self, literal % and _ (search_sunners + pgTAP)
Danh hiệu required 1-100 chars with Figma placeholder and helper text; saved as kudos.title — proof: title 1-100 enforced client, action and RPC

Editor: bold, italic, strike, numbered list, link (Add link dialog: Text 1-100, http/https URL 5-2048), quote; '@' shows sunner suggestions and inserts a mention; placeholder per Figma; 'Tiêu chuẩn cộng đồng' opens /standards in a new tab; content required, max 2000 plain chars — proof: editor whitelist + http/https links 5-2048 at client (isAllowedUri) and server (content_doc_is_valid); mention suggestions; content 1-2000

Hashtag: '+ Hashtag' opens a multi-select of DB hashtags, chips removable, min 1, at 5 unselected rows are disabled and 'Tối đa 5 hashtag' shows — proof: hashtags 1-5 existing slugs, no free-text creation (RPC + pgTAP)

Image: jpeg/png/webp up to 5 MB, max 5 thumbnails with remove; '+ Image' hidden at 5 and shown again after a removal; other types show 'Định dạng file không hợp lệ' and are not added — proof: images jpeg/png/webp <=5MB, max 5, magic-byte sniff, bucket MIME/size limits, owner-checked in create_kudo

Anonymous checkbox default unchecked; checked shows the optional alias field (max 50), unchecked hides and clears it; board shows the alias for anonymous kudos and no API reveals the real sender to other users — proof: anonymous alias <=50; sender null on cards for all viewers; column grants deny sender_id/user_id via select/filter/order/embed (pgTAP + real-stack smoke)

Gửi is aria-disabled while a required field is incomplete; clicking it then shows every field error ('Không được để trống') without submitting; errors also show on blur and clear when valid — proof: aria-disabled Gửi still clickable and reveals all errors (use-write-kudo-form, W specs)

Valid submit shows loading, inserts kudo + hashtags + images atomically via create_kudo (server re-validates every rule), closes the modal, toasts success and the new kudo is first in All Kudos; failure keeps the modal and data and shows an error toast — proof: atomic create_kudo with server re-validation; failure keeps modal and cleans up uploads; success refresh + feed re-key
Hủy and Esc close and discard; backdrop click does nothing; focus trapped and returned to the compose pill — proof: Hủy/Esc close and discard, Esc ignored while submitting, focus returns to pill

VI/EN copy parity; modal fits 1440 per Figma and has no horizontal scroll at 768 and 375; existing e2e suites and pgTAP stay green — proof: tsc 0 and lint 0 re-run; W/K/full/P/I/L/pgTAP green per evidence

content_doc not matched against content; mention label and link attrs free; matters only once a detail screen renders content_doc
